answer.rationale:
Objective is sustainable long-term qualified revenue, so promotional_pricing is ruled out despite the competitor's entry pricing: memory_73 records strong acquisition/revenue lift but a material 30-day retention drop and an explicit instruction not to generalize it. Answering price pressure with price would buy the exact revenue that memory says does not persist. referral_incentive (memory_57) is healthy but only proven in established customers and does nothing about the two measured declines. enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is sound but addresses a segment that is not the reported problem this quarter.

The live signals are onboarding completion -4% and activation -6%. Onboarding sits upstream of activation, so a completion fix plausibly recovers part of both, whereas activation messaging treats the downstream symptom. That makes simplify_onboarding my intended action, with the two verifications spent on the head-to-head: memory_86 (shortening onboarding, day 52) because it is the direct load-bearing claim, and memory_91 (activation messaging, day 61) because it is the strongest alternative and I want to know whether its week-one engagement lift was measured on the same self-serve population and whether it persisted past week one. If memory_86's original record turns out to be a completion-rate result with no durable revenue follow-through, I switch to activation_messaging.

Downstream value risk: memory_31's mechanism was cutting required signup fields. Fewer fields raises raw activation but strips the qualification and routing data that makes revenue *qualified*, and it can divert enterprise prospects out of the demo-request path that memory_44 says converts better. So the experiment should shorten and reorder onboarding steps rather than delete qualification fields, and must be read on qualified-pipeline and 30-day retention, not completion alone.

Uncertainty I am not collapsing: these memories are consolidated summaries whose effect sizes, populations, and durations I cannot see; all prior lifts were measured before the competitor's entry pricing changed the incoming mix; and the cause of the -6% activation is unknown, so it may be a mix shift rather than a funnel defect, in which case no funnel fix will fully recover it. Standard experiment scale with holdout, not a broad rollout, since I am acting on summaries plus at most two verified records.
